import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    b = int(data[1])
    cuts = []
    arr = list(map(int, data[2:2+n]))
    even = 0
    odd = 0
    
    for i in range(n):
        if i > 0 and even == odd:
            cuts.append(abs(arr[i] - arr[i-1]))
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
    
    cuts.sort()
    count = 0
    for cut in cuts:
        if cut <= b:
            count += 1
            b -= cut
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
